records.name: Pune Institute of Business Management
records.description: Pune Institute of Business Management (PIBM) is a highly regarded private business school in Pune offering PGDM programs with strong emphasis on industry immersion, live projects, and corporate mentoring. PIBM maintains consistent placement records with leading companies in FMCG, banking, IT, and manufacturing. The institute is known for its management games, simulations, and industry speaker series that provide students practical exposure from day one.

records.name: Symbiosis School of Sports Sciences
records.description: Symbiosis School of Sports Sciences (SSSS) in Pune is a specialized institution under Symbiosis International University offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sports sciences, sports management, and physical education. The school integrates academic rigor with practical sports training, taking advantage of Symbiosis's extensive sports infrastructure. SSSS caters to a growing demand for sports management professionals, fitness scientists, and sports psychologists in India's rapidly developing sports sector.

records.name: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports
records.description: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS) in Patiala is India's premier sports coaching and physical education institution. It offers diploma and master's programs in sports coaching across 30+ sports disciplines and functions as the umbrella organization of the National Institute of Sports. NSNIS trains coaches who serve at the national team, SAI training centers, and state sports academies, making it the cornerstone of India's coaching talent development ecosystem.

records.name: National Academy of Sports Management
records.description: National Academy of Sports Management (NASM) in Mumbai is a specialized institution offering postgraduate and professional programs in sports management, sports marketing, and event management. It provides practical training for sports administrators, managers, and marketers serving IPL franchises, sports federations, and sports marketing agencies. NASM has faculty from the corporate sports world and places graduates in positions with sports bodies, media companies, and fitness industry organizations.

records.name: International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)
records.description: International Institute of Sports Management (IISM) in Mumbai is India's first dedicated sports management institute, offering PGDM and MBA programs in sports management. IISM has placed thousands of graduates in roles with cricket boards, football clubs, sports brands like Nike and Adidas, and sports media companies. The institute is known for its close relationships with the BCCI, ISL clubs, and other Indian sports organizations that offer students internship and placement opportunities.

records.name: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management
records.description: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management in Mumbai is a highly ranked private business school offering MBA (MMS), PGDM, and executive programs with strong specializations in finance, marketing, and business analytics. It is consistently ranked among the top 20 business schools in India and benefits from its Mumbai location for industry exposure and placements. K.J. Somaiya's alumni network spans BFSI, consulting, FMCG, and technology sectors across India.

records.name: National Law School of India University
records.description: National Law School of India University (NLSIU) in Bangalore is India's premier law school, founded in 1987, and consistently ranked #1 in law by NIRF. It pioneered the five-year integrated B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) program in India, now the template for all National Law Universities. NLSIU graduates command the highest salaries in India's legal job market, with alumni serving as Supreme Court judges, partners at top law firms, legal advisors to the government, and international arbitrators.

records.name: National University of Advanced Legal Studies
records.description: National University of Advanced Legal Studies (NUALS) in Kochi is a prominent National Law University in Kerala, offering the five-year B.A. LL.B. program and LL.M. degree with strengths in maritime law, business law, and intellectual property law. Being located in Kochi provides unique opportunities for maritime law specialization and connections with Kerala's large expatriate business community. NUALS is recognized for its strong research output and international moot court participation.

records.name: University School of Law and Legal Studies, GGSIPU
records.description: University School of Law and Legal Studies under Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) in New Delhi offers B.A. LL.B., LL.B., LL.M., and Ph.D. programs and is one of the top law schools in Delhi's university system. The school is known for producing competent legal practitioners for Delhi's vibrant legal market and places graduates in district courts, high courts, law firms, and corporate legal departments. Its location in the national capital gives students exposure to Supreme Court proceedings and legislative processes.

records.name: National Sports University
records.description: National Sports University (NSU) in Imphal, Manipur is India's first national sports university, established in 2018 as an Institution of National Importance, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in sports sciences, sports coaching, sports technology, and sports management. It aims to create world-class sports professionals to power India's Olympic aspirations and has state-of-the-art sports infrastructure and residential facilities. NSU draws students from across India with a focus on producing evidence-based coaches, sports scientists, and administrators.
